personal.bio: I'm a fullstack developer with deep expertise in backend architecture, API design, and database optimization. I build scalable, maintainable systems that power great user experiences.

description: Providing technical solutions and customizing Microsoft Business Central ERP modules using AL language according to business process needs.
Design and implementation system architecture and database schema for web applications and mobile applications.
Integrating Microsoft D365 Business Central with several web applications and mobile applications using REST API and OData.

Develop and maintain web applications (internal apps and company product) using several technologies such as Vue, .NET, React TS, Nest JS or mobile applications using Flutter, integrated with the Microsoft Business Central platform.
Participating in supporting the development on web-based applications with React.js, Next.js, .NET Framework, and Golang based on product and design requirements provided.
Conducting research and implementation of various technology such as Google Recaptcha, Google Indexing, Next JS and Golang deployment on IIS, and improving website performance on React.JS.
Teaching beginner-level bootcamp classes on JavaScript programming and programming logic.
Guiding advanced Fullstack Engineer bootcamp participants in completing their given final project under academic team guidance.
Deploying web-based applications on Windows Server.
Conducting workshops and performing computer maintenance at Gunadarma University's laboratory.
Learning Back-End API development using JavaScript.
Studying Cloud Architecture with Google Cloud Platform.
Collaborating in a team to develop a vegetable freshness classification application utilizing Google Cloud services.
Collaborating with team and creating user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
